gaps.lead: Pay claims must be submitted before the end of the month.
gaps.sentence: You have ___ your pay claims before the end of the month.
gaps.explanation: 'Must be submitted' becomes 'you have to put in your claims'.

gaps.lead: He spoke slowly so that the interpreter could follow.
I rarely drink coffee in the evening.
gaps.explanation: be (not) used to something = (not) accustomed to it.

gaps.lead: Living in the city is new to her.
gaps.sentence: She is not ___ in the city.
gaps.explanation: 'Be used to living' = be accustomed to (note the gerund).

gaps.lead: They won't allow you to enter without a ticket.
gaps.sentence: You ___ to enter without a ticket.
gaps.explanation: 'They won't allow you' becomes 'you won't be allowed'.

gaps.lead: There isn't a single clean cup left in the cupboard.
gaps.hint: run out of = have none left
gaps.explanation: run out of = have no more of something left.
